## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] The change is focused on a single topic
- [ ] Commit messages follow the [commit message convention](../docs/contributing/commit-message-convention.md)
- [ ] Documentation affected by this change is updated in the same pull request
- [ ] `npx --yes markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"` passes locally
- [ ] User-facing changes are recorded under the `Unreleased` heading in [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md)
